body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 0051b764f29d477306a06cdc9eed30849837ef6d -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

An earlier comment on this head carries a pr-reviewer marker from the author's own run. AGENTS.md ("Only collaborators' reviews count") asks for a review by an agent that did not write the change. This review is that one.

**What looks good**
- The four folders listed in #1794 are gone. `git ls-files docs/pr-1711 docs/pr-1771 docs/review/1765 docs/reviews/1756` prints nothing on the merged tree.
- No file in the tree names the removed folders, except the four path strings in the new pin test.
- `docs/decisions/1794-review-screenshots.md` follows `docs/decisions/README.md`. It records the #1771 scope question and notes that this change supersedes the earlier retain decisions.
- The edits to `docs/decisions/1122-form-seam-holes.md`, `docs/decisions/1727-boundary-edges.md` and `docs/reviews/1724/README.md` replace folder references with PR links only. The decisions keep their history.
- The PR body carries `Process change: yes`, and the PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The one commit has a conventional subject, and its body ends with the closing keyword for #1794.
- No file under `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/` changed. The deleted PNGs are review evidence under `docs/`, not pixel goldens.

**Results (built locally in a review worktree; no runner)**
- Trial merge with `origin/main` db091cb38: clean, no conflicts. The merge commit exists in the review worktree only; nothing was pushed.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 137 unit tests and 1 integration test passed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation check: `git checkout origin/main -- docs/reviews/1756` made `reviewed_screenshot_directories_are_absent` fail and name `docs/reviews/1756`. Removing the folder made it pass again.
- `git diff --check` on the PR changes: clean.
- Site build: not exercised. Zola is not installed on this machine. A text search found no site file that names the removed paths.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The cleanup is partial. Main carries four more artifact folders that #1794 did not list: `docs/review/1744/` (2 PNGs), `docs/reviews/1699/` (README and 2 PNGs), `docs/reviews/1710/` (README and 4 PNGs), and `docs/reviews/1724/` (6 PNGs and a check script). Issue #1845 tracks them (P7, effort:low). It also names the opt-in capture hook in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/edge_click_modifiers.rs:227`; that hook creates its output folder, so a refresh run can recreate a folder the pin test rejects.
- The pin test lists four folders. When #1845 lands, its list grows with it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
